alpha.profile_formula: two straight fixed x columns +/-2.5mm; radius0.8mm*(1-height/tip)^.38; tip .92..96; unchanged60x28resampling

candidate.length_rule: base_length_m * existing groom_flow length_scale evaluated at each fixed root midpoint
candidate.comb_rule: existing groom_flow comb and direction at the same root; no species/color coordinates or fitted thresholds
candidate.measurement_scope: Counterfactual fixed-root projection only. Future versioned policy applies regional response after unchanged selection; no candidate model/render exists.
candidate.rationale: Shorter regional fins reduce contour reach while the already-authored native comb exposes more projected area on nearly face-on surfaces. This reuses previously discarded regional length/comb, not added density.

limitations: Projected area is a summed unoccluded alpha-area proxy, not visible fur/body coverage. No depth raster, overlap, lighting, GPU mip or temporal antialiasing measured.
Luminance bands sample existing atlas source colors at two nominal tips, not total eligible dark/bright surface area. Counts alone cannot prove color-biased root allocation.
Nearest root distance is a3D chord, not geodesic distance; folded surfaces can be close.
Actual source contact/cap defects remain separate; no masks, geometry, colors or normal maps are changed.
720and256 use the exact rest-camera recipe;256is an analytic projected display size, not a new native image.
No proposed setting is quality accepted. Native material detail remains lighting-dependent and not volumetric fur.
